title: Valses nobles et sentimentales - Valse IV (Assez animé)
notable_excerpt: Key: Ab major. Chord journey: I - vi - flat-side sequence (bVI7 - bIII - bII+7 - bII7) over IV6, cycles back to I, ends on bVI6 with chromatic colour left hanging. Texture: chromatic waltz, dense chords in right hand with quick chromatic inner eighths.
video_use_ideas: Elegant, slightly off-kilter waltz colour for a film-score sketch.
legal_notes: US public domain only (composer died 1937; work published 1911, before 1931). Also public domain in the EU / life+70 countries (composer died 1937); only this pre-1931 publication is US-PD, later works by the composer are not. OCR draft: score made by optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) from the public-domain Durand 1912 print scan https://archive.org/details/imslp-nobles-et-sentimentales-ravel-maurice, then corrected (Claude Opus). Method: OMR from PD scan, corrected. Bar count matches the scan and every bar has the correct duration; estimated pitch accuracy ~90% from spot checks. MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES; slurs, pedal and most grace notes not encoded. Transcription by LaDoger's library, released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/ravel_m61_valses_nobles_4.musicxml. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
